2558-2981-8347--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-2981-8347--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Sela triggers. Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

224-907-1772-8345.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5413-8293.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5413-8293.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5413-8293.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

1722-2034-3583-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6752.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

5702-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4699-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-4699-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

628-7213-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Encumbered Reejerey.
When Encumbered Reejerey dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

When Cold-Blooded Crew enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.

Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2661-3692-7646.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {U}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

1775-2968-6831.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
1775-2968-6831.description:
Cast Ajani's Presence by paying {2}{W}{W} total, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Cast Toralf by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Neriv.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Neriv.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
1775-2968-6831.notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

Repeat from step 2.

At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.

Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.

When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.

1621-6406-6867.notes: If you control another creature, you can reduce the cost by {1} and tap that creature in step 3 instead of paying mana.

997-1636-6773.description:

Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters
